acceptance: Operations written by a separate annotation session are proven by an independent reference driver, then run through recognized units only; results separate verified, fallback, wrong effect and misbound; the pre-B11, T02 and current recognizers are measured on the frozen denominator; held-out stays aggregate-only.

positive.fixture: 199 frozen operations (142 development and validation, 42 + 15 held-out); reference-confirmed 175; pre-B11, T02 and current builds measured with identical harness

negative.fixture: planted wrong-effect and misbound targets are classified, unconfirmed operations are never counted as verified, dropped operations are refused

versions.schema: operations.frozen.json and operations.triage.json added; result gains diagnostic classes

security_and_source_permissions: The reference driver and the executor run on loopback copies of the sources with disposable state; credential fields are withheld and counted information_limit.
performance_memory_storage: Operation runs execute in parallel workers; fixtures grow by the frozen list and the triage file.
known_limitations: Operations come from model annotation sessions; 15 development and validation operations are annotation defects and 4 are information limits
Reference limits (4 development, 1 open, 3 sealed) cannot be confirmed by the reference driver and are never counted as verified
Held-out independence is consumed for AdminLTE and TodoMVC (diagnosed) and for File Browser (one late look)
